summary: A 65-year-old hiker accidentally fell 15-20 ft from the top of Mount Royal near Frisco onto a rock pile; more than two dozen Summit County Rescue Group members carried out a roughly four-hour litter evacuation with oxygen/IV care en route
notes: Incident date Sunday 2014-10-19 per the Vail Daily feed item reposted by Vail Chamber (Ben Trollinger); page carries only the lede, full story truncated. Summit 2014 thin year: 3rd row.
